scripts.build:widget: vite build --config vite.widget.config.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const css=fs.readFileSync('dist-widget/style.css','utf8');const js=fs.readFileSync('dist-widget/widget.js','utf8');const inject='(function(){var s=document.createElement(\"style\");s.textContent='+JSON.stringify(css)+';document.head.appendChild(s);})();';fs.writeFileSync('dist-widget/widget.js',inject+js);fs.unlinkSync('dist-widget/style.css');console.log('✅ CSS injecté dans widget.js');"
